information: While this competition does have most "normal" events, due to the small competitor limit 3x3 will not be held at this competition. Because of the small competitor limit, every competitor MUST help throughout the day for the competition to stay on schedule. If you are finished competing we encourage you to stay until the end to help with running, judging, and scrambling the final few groups. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcXBEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3440ef949907336b2807b1eb73f2734f6349e226/image.png)
